cards.front: With a modern transvaginal probe, polycystic ovarian morphology is defined as [___] or more follicles in at least one ovary.
cards.context:
Since the 2018 international guideline the count is 2–9 mm follicles in at least one ovary, up from Rotterdam's 12. Volume of 10 mL or more is used only when follicles cannot be counted.

In adults, a raised AMH can replace the scan.
